name: Quick QR Scanner
shortDescription: Fast, simple QR code and barcode scanner with scan history and privacy controls.
fullDescription:
Quick QR Scanner is a fast and simple QR code and barcode scanner designed for everyday use.

Scan QR codes and popular 1D barcodes using your device camera, or select an image from your gallery to scan. Results are displayed clearly so you can quickly view and use the information you scanned.

### Key Features

• Fast QR code scanning
• Supports popular 1D barcodes including EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93 and ITF
• Supports PDF417, Aztec and Data Matrix formats
• Scan directly with your camera
• Scan an existing image from your gallery
• Automatic URL opening option
• Scan history for reviewing previous scans
• Delete individual scan records or clear your entire scan history
• Vibration and scan sound controls
• Light, Dark and System theme options
• No account required
• Simple and easy-to-use interface
• Privacy-focused design with scan processing performed on your device

### Scan History

Your scan results can be saved locally on your device so you can review them later. You can delete individual records or clear your entire scan history whenever you want.

### Privacy

Quick QR Scanner does not require an account. Camera frames and barcode scanning are processed on your device. Scan history and app settings are stored locally on your device.

The app contains Google AdMob banner advertising on the Home and History screens. Ad-related data may be collected by Google to provide and measure advertising services.

For complete information about data collection and privacy, please review our Privacy Policy.

Quick QR Scanner by LLCAI Labs.

Made for fast, convenient and straightforward QR code and barcode scanning.

name: mPOS — Mobile Point of Sale
shortDescription: Offline mobile POS for small shops: sales, inventory, checkout, and backup.
fullDescription:
mPOS — Mobile Point of Sale is an offline-first POS app designed for small shops, stalls, and mobile sellers.

Manage products, inventory, sales, checkout, and receipts directly from your Android device. mPOS works without an account or an internet connection for everyday POS operations.

KEY FEATURES

• Product & inventory management
Add products with names, prices, categories, SKUs, stock quantities, and low-stock thresholds. Edit prices, archive products, or mark items as unlimited stock.

• Fast checkout
Tap products to add them to the cart, adjust quantities, review the total, and complete the sale. A 5-sen cash rounding option is available for Malaysian users.

• Price override
Apply a temporary price override to individual items during checkout. The original product price remains unchanged.

• Sales history
View previous orders by date and open individual orders to see item details, totals, and receipt information.

• Receipt printing
Connect a compatible Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printer for 58mm or 80mm paper receipts. Print receipts after checkout or reprint them from order history.

• Stock & restock
Monitor stock levels with low-stock indicators. Quickly restock products using preset quantities or enter a custom quantity.

• Reports
Review sales information and stock-related information to help monitor your shop's daily activity.

• Backup & restore
Create backup files and save them locally or optionally back them up to your Google Drive. Restore your product, order, inventory, and settings data when needed.

• Multi-language
Available in English, Bahasa Malaysia, Bahasa Indonesia, and Simplified Chinese.

• Tax & currency
Configure the applicable SST rate and currency code. MYR is the default currency.

OFFLINE-FIRST

mPOS is designed to work offline. No mPOS account is required and everyday POS data is stored locally on your device.

Google Drive backup is optional. When you choose to use it, mPOS uses Google Drive to store and restore your backup data.

SUPPORTED DEVICES

Android 8.0 (API 26) or later.

IMPORTANT

mPOS is a business management and point-of-sale tool. It does not process card payments or provide banking, financial, lending, or payment services.

The app does not provide tax or legal advice. Tax rates and settings should be configured according to your business requirements and applicable local regulations.
